description: Mono mixer channel strip for the older cable-linked Daisy Mix chain, adding its signal to a daisy signal passed by cable from strip to strip

params.text: Sets the level of this strip, silence at the bottom and 0dB at the top, though the tooltip reads half the attenuation applied, so its -6dB is really -12dB
Mutes the strip, so neither the OUT jack nor the daisy output carries it

inputs.text: The signal into this strip, taken through the fader and the level CV
Scales the level of this strip, 0-10V for silence to the fader setting, with voltage outside that range clamped
Takes the daisy signal from the previous strip in the chain, which this strip adds its own signal to

outputs.text: This strip after the fader, the level CV and the mute
Carries the daisy input plus this strip's signal at a sixteenth of its level, for the next strip or for a DSY-MX master

notes: This module is hidden from the module browser and stays for patches built before the touching-module Daisy Mix strips
